Automatic Deletion After Successful Export\n18\tWhen the user successfully exports the completed file via `share()` or `save()`:\n19\t- **Delete the OPFS artefact immediately** after the export succeeds\n20\t- Clear all associated metadata from OPFS\n21\t- Do NOT wait for tab close or browser exit — the file is no longer needed\n22\t\n23\t### 2. positives during:\n23\t- Normal app restart (e.g., browser update, device reboot)\n24\t- Session resume (D22) where a paused session becomes active again\n25\t- Brief app closure during long cleaned up\n37\t- Logs each deletion with file details (streamId, filename, age)\n38\t\n39\t**`runStartupCleanup(activeStreamIds: Set<number>)`**\n40\t\n41\t- Convenience wrapper around storage manager\n42\t- Returns `{ cleaned: number, error?: string }`\n43\t- Handles errors gracefully (returns 0 cleaned on failure)\n44\t\n45\t### App Initialization (`src/platform/init.ts`)\n46\t\n47\t**`runAppInit()`**\n48\t\n49\t- Runs startup cleanup in parallel with health check\n50\t- Uses empty `Set()` for active stream IDs (no active sessions on in Promise.all with health check, so UI loads immediately without waiting for cleanup to complete.\n55\t\n56\t## Configuration\n57\t\n58\t### StorageManagerConfig\n59\t\n60\t```typescript\n61\t{\n62\t These orphaned files accumulate over time, consuming storage quota with no way to recover them.\n\n## Solution\n\nOn app startup, scan for and automatically delete orphaned output files.\n\n## Orphan Criteria\n\nAn output file is considered orphaned when **BOTH** conditions are met:\n\n1. **No active session reference**: The file's `streamId` is not in the set of currently active session IDs\n2. **Older than max age**: The file's `createdAt` timestamp exceeds `maxOrphanAge` (default: 24 hours)\n\nThe age threshold prevents false positives during:\n- Normal app restart (e.g., browser update, device reboot)\n- Session resume (D22) where a paused session becomes active again\n- Brief app closure during long transfers\n\n## Implementation\n\n### Storage Manager (`src/platform/storage.ts`)\n\n**`OPFSStorageManager.cleanupOrphanedOutputs(activeStreamIds: Set<number>)`**\n\n- Lists all output metadata files (`.meta.json`)\n- Checks each output against orphan criteria\n- Deletes both data file (`.bin`) and metadata file (`.meta.json`)\n- Returns count of files cleaned up\n- Logs each deletion with file details (streamId, filename, age)\n\n**`runStartupCleanup(activeStreamIds: Set<number>)`**\n\n- Convenience wrapper around storage manager\n- Returns `{ cleaned: number, error?: string }`\n- Handles errors gracefully (returns 0 cleaned on failure)\n\n### App Initialization (`src/platform/init.ts`)\n\n**`runAppInit()`**\n\n- Runs startup cleanup in parallel with health check\n- Uses empty `Set()` for active stream IDs (no active sessions on startup)\n- Returns `InitResult` with `orphanedOutputsCleaned` count\n- Logs initialization results (health status, cleanup count, errors)\n\n**Non-blocking execution**: Cleanup runs in Promise.all with health check, so UI loads immediately without waiting for cleanup to complete.\n\n## Configuration\n\n### StorageManagerConfig\n\n```typescript\n{\n  outputDirectory: string;      // OPFS subdirectory (default: 'screenferry-outputs')\n  maxOrphanAge: number;        // Max age for orphans in ms (default: 24 hours)\n}\n```\n\n### Custom Configuration\n\n```typescript\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Must be called before first getStorageManager() call\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  outputDirectory: 'custom-outputs',\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour\n});\n```\n\n## Usage\n\n### During App Initialization\n\n```typescript\nimport { runAppInit } from './platform/init.js';\n\n// Called during app startup\nconst result = await runAppInit();\n\nconsole.log(`Cleaned ${result.orphanedOutputsCleaned} orphaned files`);\n```\n\n### Manual Cleanup (Advanced)\n\n```typescript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst activeIds = new Set<number>([123, 456]); // Currently active streams\nconst cleaned = await storage.cleanupOrphanedOutputs(activeIds);\n```\n\n## Testing\n\n### Unit Tests (`test/storage.test.ts`)\n\n- **Age-based orphan detection**: Removes files older than max age\n- **Active session protection**: Keeps files in active set regardless of age\n- **Recent file protection**: Keeps recent files even if not active\n- **Empty storage handling**: Handles no-op case gracefully\n- **Mixed age handling**: Correctly filters mixed-age files\n- **Error handling**: Continues cleanup even if individual deletions fail\n- **Configuration options**: Respects custom `maxOrphanAge`\n\n### Integration Tests (`test/init.test.ts`)\n\n- **Parallel execution**: Runs cleanup alongside health check\n- **Error collection**: Collects errors from both cleanup and health check\n- **Result formatting**: Formats user-friendly status messages\n- **Logging verification**: Verifies console output\n\n## Metrics and Logging\n\n### Console Logs\n\n```\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleaning up orphaned output: streamId=123, filename=test.dat, age=45 minutes\n[Storage] Deleted output: streamId=123\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n[Init] Initialization complete in 234ms\n[Init] Health check: PASSED\n[Init] Orphaned outputs cleaned: 3\n```\n\n### Return Values\n\n- `runAppInit()` → `InitResult` with `orphanedOutputsCleaned` count\n- `cleanupOrphanedOutputs()` → `number` (count of files removed)\n- `runStartupCleanup()` → `{ cleaned: number, error?: string }`\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n- **Same-origin restriction**: OPFS is origin-private, no cross-origin access\n- **No user data exposure**: Cleanup only removes app's own output files\n- **No active session disruption**: Age threshold prevents deleting recent files that might be in use\n\n## Performance\n\n- **Non-blocking**: Runs in background, doesn't block app initialization\n- **Incremental**: Processes files one at a time, no large memory allocations\n- **Fast for typical usage**: Most apps have 0-2 orphaned files\n- **Graceful degradation**: Continues on individual deletion failures\n\n## Future Enhancements\n\n- **Configurable age threshold**: Allow users to set custom orphan age in settings\n- **Manual cleanup button**: UI button to trigger cleanup on demand\n- **Cleanup statistics**: Track cleanup frequency and file age distribution\n- **User notification**: Show toast when orphans are cleaned up\n\n## References\n\n- **Storage implementation**: `src/platform/storage.ts`\n- **Init integration**: `src/platform/init.ts`\n- **Session types**: `src/core/session/types.ts`\n- **Tests**: `test/storage.test.ts`, `test/init.test.ts`\n- **Bead**: bf-ho40\n\n## Why: \n\nWithout automatic cleanup, orphaned files accumulate indefinitely:\n- Each incomplete transfer leaves a partial file in OPFS\n- OPFS quota is limited (typically ~50-60% of total storage)\n- No built-in cleanup mechanism in The bytes go from screen to lens.\n38\t- **Provably no exfiltration** — a static page with no network calls can be\n39\t  audited once and trusted thereafter.\n40\t\n41\t## The hard part\n42\t\n43\tThe channel is **strictly one-way**. The sender has no idea how the receiver is\n44\tdoing — there is no ACK, no retransmit request, no back-channel of any kind. The\n45\treceiver *will* miss frames: autofocus hunting, motion blur, glare, the user\n46\tlooking away.\n47\t\n48\tA naive \"loop through chunks 1..N forever\" transfer degrades badly under loss\n49\t(the coupon-collector problem — the last few chunks take agonizingly long).\n50\tscreenferry's design centers on **rateless erasure coding**: the sender emits an\n51\tendless stream of encoded frames, and the receiver reconstructs the file once it\n52\thas collected *any* sufficient subset. Miss a frame and it simply doesn't\n53\tmatter — the next one is just as useful.\n54\t\n55\t## Status\n56\t\n57\t**Research complete. Phase 1 core codec built (22 tests green). Phase 0 harness and Phase 0.5 spike both partial** — see [`docs/plan/plan.md`](docs/plan/plan.md) §17.2.\n58\t\n59\t- [`docs/plan/plan.md`](docs/plan/plan.md) — the complete application plan\n60\t- [`docs/notes/`](docs/notes/) — design decisions and constraints specific to screenferry\n61\t- [`docs/research/`](docs/research/) — findings:\n62\t  - `qr-encoding-capacity.md` — QR versions, EC levels, bytes per frame, JS encoders\n63\t  - `browser-qr-scanning.md` — camera capture, decoder libraries, binary safety\n64\t  - `fountain-codes-and-protocol.md` — erasure coding for a one-way channel, wire format\n65\t  - `beyond-qr-optical-channels.md` — color barcodes, screen-camera research, what beats QR\n66\t  - `custom-codec-engineering.md` — feasibility of a purpose-built codec in a browser\n67\t  - `pwa-platform-and-ux.md` — offline PWA, file I/O, iOS constraints, UX, testing\n68\t\n69\t## Expectations\n70\t\n71\tThis is not a fast pipe. Realistic throughput is on the order of **kilobytes per\n72\tsecond** — good for keys, configs, documents, and small archives; not for video.\n73\tThe app is designed to be honest about this up front rather than let a user start\n74\ta transfer that would take an hour.\n75\t\n76\t## License\n77\t\n78\tMIT\n79\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"call_afcdaffb70f24be69443c422","session_id":"27c2eebc-7a19-458d-b38b-927127a0d18d","uuid":"c95bee62-5bb4-4fa4-8441-742fb4b6758b","timestamp":"2026-08-03T00:05:16.181Z","subagent_type":"Explore","task_description":"Search deletion-related code and docs"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"msg_20260803080528c1b0c48cd5c844cb","type":"message","role":"assistant","model":"glm-4.7","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"call_2172246e25f94e6389e9d694","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/coding/screenferry/docs/bf-9g4i-deletion-lifecycle-and-troubleshooting.md","content":"# Deletion Lifecycle and Troubleshooting Guide (bf-9g4i)\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document explains the complete deletion lifecycle for receiver output files in ScreenFerry, including when files are automatically deleted versus retained, how to verify deletion is working correctly, and how to troubleshoot common deletion issues.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Deletion Lifecycle](#deletion-lifecycle)\n- [When Files Are Deleted vs Retained](#when-files-are-deleted-vs-retained)\n- [Verifying Deletion in Production](#verifying-deletion-in-production)\n- [Troubleshooting Common Issues](#troubleshooting-common-issues)\n- [Manual OPFS Cleanup](#manual-opfs-cleanup)\n- [Log Output Examples](#log-output-examples)\n\n## Deletion Lifecycle\n\n### 1. File Creation\n\nWhen a file is successfully received and decoded:\n\n```\n[Storage] Stored output: streamId=123, size=1024000\n```\n\nFiles are stored in OPFS under `screenferry-outputs/` directory:\n- **Data file**: `output-{streamId}.bin`\n- **Metadata file**: `output-{streamId}.meta.json`\n\n### 2. Active Retention\n\nFiles are **retained** during active transfers:\n- File remains in OPFS while transfer is in progress\n- File remains accessible after successful completion\n- User can download/view the completed file\n\n### 3. Manual Deletion\n\nUsers can manually delete files via the File List UI:\n\n```\n[FileListUI] Deleted file: example.jpg (streamId: 123)\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Data file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.bin\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Metadata file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.meta.json\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { streamId: 123, duration: \"12.45ms\" }\n```\n\n### 4. Automatic Cleanup\n\nOrphaned files are automatically cleaned up on app startup:\n\n```\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleaning up orphaned output: streamId=123, age=45 minutes\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n```\n\n## When Files Are Deleted vs Retained\n\n### Files Are Deleted Automatically When:\n\n1. **Orphaned files on startup**: Files older than 24 hours without active session reference\n2. **Age threshold reached**: `createdAt` timestamp exceeds `maxOrphanAge` (default: 24 hours)\n3. **No active session**: File's `streamId` not in active session set\n\n### Files Are Retained When:\n\n1. **Active transfer**: File is part of an ongoing transfer session\n2. **Recent completion**: File was created recently (within 24 hours)\n3. **Active session reference**: File belongs to a paused/resumable session\n4. **User intent**: File hasn't been manually deleted by user\n\n### Deletion Safety Mechanisms\n\n**Age Threshold Protection**: Prevents accidental deletion during:\n- Normal app restart (browser update, device reboot)\n- Session resume (paused sessions becoming active again)\n- Brief app closure during long transfers\n\n**Active Session Protection**: Files in active session set are never auto-deleted regardless of age.\n\n## Verifying Deletion in Production\n\n### 1. Console Log Monitoring\n\nCheck browser console for deletion activity:\n\n**Successful manual deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.000Z\" \n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  duration: \"12.45ms\" \n}\n```\n\n**Failed deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Failed to delete output {\n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\",\n  error: {\n    name: \"NotFoundError\", \n    message: \"File not found\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 2. Startup Cleanup Verification\n\nCheck app initialization logs:\n\n```javascript\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n[Init] Orphaned outputs cleaned: 3\n```\n\n### 3. Storage Quota Monitoring\n\nMonitor storage usage changes after deletion:\n\n```javascript\n// Before deletion\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('Before:', e));\n\n// After deletion should show reduced usage\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('After:', e));\n```\n\n### 4. Programmatic Verification\n\nUse the storage manager API to verify deletion:\n\n```typescript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\n\n// Check if file exists (should return null after deletion)\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (metadata === null) {\n  console.log('File successfully deleted');\n}\n\n// List all remaining files\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nconsole.log('Remaining files:', files.length);\n```\n\n## Troubleshooting Common Issues\n\n### Issue 1: Files Not Being Deleted Automatically\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- Old files accumulating in OPFS\n- No cleanup logs on app startup\n- Storage quota warnings\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check console for `[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...` log\n2. Verify `runStartupCleanup()` is called during app initialization\n3. Check if files are younger than 24-hour age threshold\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Verify startup cleanup is running\n// Check src/platform/init.ts for runAppInit() call\n\n// Lower age threshold for testing\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000 // 1 hour for testing\n});\n```\n\n### Issue 2: Manual Deletion Failing Silently\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- User clicks delete but file remains\n- No error toast shown\n- No console logs\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check browser console for `[Storage:Deletion]` logs\n2. Verify OPFS permissions\n3. Check if file is locked by another process\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Check if file exists before deletion\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (!metadata) {\n  console.log('File already deleted or never existed');\n}\n\n// Force refresh file list after deletion\nawait fileListUI.refreshFileList();\n```\n\n### Issue 3: Deletion Logs Show \"File Not Found\"\n\n**Symptoms:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Files not found (already deleted) {\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"example.jpg\"\n}\n```\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n- File was already deleted (normal condition)\n- Metadata/file mismatch\n- Race condition in deletion\n\n**Solutions:**\n- This is a **warning, not an error** - deletion is idempotent\n- File is already gone, no action needed\n- Verify UI file list is synchronized\n\n### Issue 4: OPFS Storage Quota Exhausted\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- New transfers fail with quota errors\n- Deletion doesn't free up space\n- `navigator.storage.estimate()` shows 0 available\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n```javascript\nconst estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();\nconsole.log('Available:', estimate.quota - estimate.usage);\nconsole.log('Usage:', estimate.usage);\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n1. **Manual cleanup**: Delete old files programmatically\n2. **Browser data clearing**: Clear site data via DevTools\n3. **Reduce orphan age**: Auto-cleanup more frequently\n\n```javascript\n// Emergency cleanup - delete all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nfor (const file of files) {\n  await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n}\n```\n\n### Issue 5: Deletion Performance Problems\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- UI freezes during deletion\n- Long duration times in logs\n- Multiple file deletions blocking UI\n\n**Diagnosis:**\nCheck deletion duration in logs:\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  duration: \"1250.45ms\"  // > 1 second indicates problem\n}\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Batch deletions with delays to avoid UI blocking\nasync function deleteMultipleFiles(streamIds: number[]) {\n  for (const streamId of streamIds) {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(streamId);\n    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // 100ms delay\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Manual OPFS Cleanup\n\n### When Manual Cleanup Is Needed\n\n- Automatic cleanup failing to run\n- Emergency storage quota recovery\n- Testing and development scenarios\n- User-requested data clearing\n\n### Method 1: Using Browser DevTools\n\n1. **Open DevTools** → Application → Storage\n2. **Find OPFS** section under \"Storage\"\n3. **Locate origin** for your ScreenFerry app\n4. **Expand \"File System\"** to see stored files\n5. **Delete files individually** or clear entire origin\n\n### Method 2: Using Storage Manager API\n\n```javascript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Get all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\n\n// Delete specific file\nawait storage.deleteOutput(streamId, filename);\n\n// Delete all files (emergency cleanup)\nfor (const file of files) {\n  try {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n    console.log(`Deleted: ${file.filename}`);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`Failed to delete: ${file.filename}`, error);\n  }\n}\n\n// Run orphaned cleanup manually\nconst activeIds = new Set<number>(); // No active sessions\nconst cleaned = await storage.cleanupOrphanedOutputs(activeIds);\nconsole.log(`Cleaned ${cleaned} orphaned files`);\n```\n\n### Method 3: Clear Site Data\n\n```javascript\n// Clear all OPFS data for the origin\nawait navigator.storage.delete();\n\n// Alternatively, use clear site data via browser UI\n// Chrome: Settings → Privacy → Site Settings → Storage → Your site\n```\n\n### Method 4: Low-Level OPFS Access\n\n```javascript\n// Direct OPFS access for advanced troubleshooting\nconst root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\nconst outputsDir = await root.getDirectoryHandle('screenferry-outputs');\n\n// List all files\nfor await (const entry of outputsDir.values()) {\n  console.log('File:', entry.name);\n  \n  // Delete specific file\n  if (entry.kind === 'file') {\n    await outputsDir.removeEntry(entry.name);\n    console.log('Deleted:', entry.name);\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Log Output Examples\n\n### Successful Manual Deletion\n\n```javascript\n[FileListUI] Deleted file: photo.jpg (streamId: 456)\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion {\n  streamId: 456,\n  filename: \"photo.jpg\",\n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:15:30.123Z\"\n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Deleting files {\n  streamId: 456,\n  filename: \"photo.jpg\",\n  files: [\"output-456.bin\", \"output-456.meta.json\"]\n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Data file deleted {\n  streamId: 456,\n  file: \"output-456.bin\"\n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Metadata file deleted {\n  streamId: 456,\n  file: \"output-456.meta.json\"\n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully {\n  streamId: 456,\n  filename: \"photo.jpg\",\n  duration: \"8.23ms\",\n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:15:30.131Z\"\n}\n```\n\n### Failed Deletion (File Not File Creation\n\nWhen a file is successfully received and decoded:\n\n```\n[Storage] Stored output: streamId=123, size=1024000\n```\n\nFiles are stored in OPFS under `screenferry-outputs/` directory:\n- **Data file**: `output-{streamId}.bin`\n- **Metadata file**: `output-{streamId}.meta.json`\n\n### 2. Active Retention\n\nFiles are **retained** during active transfers:\n- File remains in OPFS while transfer is in progress\n- File remains accessible after successful completion\n- User can download/view the completed file\n\n### 3. Manual Deletion\n\nUsers can manually delete files via the File List UI:\n\n```\n[FileListUI] Deleted file: example.jpg (streamId: 123)\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Data file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.bin\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Metadata file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.meta.json\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { streamId: 123, duration: \"12.45ms\" }\n```\n\n### 4. Automatic Cleanup\n\nOrphaned files are automatically cleaned up on app startup:\n\n```\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleaning up orphaned output: streamId=123, age=45 minutes\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n```\n\n## When Files Are Deleted vs Retained\n\n### Files Are Deleted Automatically When:\n\n1. **Orphaned files on startup**: Files older than 24 hours without active session reference\n2. **Age threshold reached**: `createdAt` timestamp exceeds `maxOrphanAge` (default: 24 hours)\n3. **No active session**: File's `streamId` not in active session set\n\n### Files Are Retained When:\n\n1. **Active transfer**: File is part of an ongoing transfer session\n2. **Recent completion**: File was created recently (within 24 hours)\n3. **Active session reference**: File belongs to a paused/resumable session\n4. **User intent**: File hasn't been manually deleted by user\n\n### Deletion Safety Mechanisms\n\n**Age Threshold Protection**: Prevents accidental deletion during:\n- Normal app restart (browser update, device reboot)\n- Session resume (paused sessions becoming active again)\n- Brief app closure during long transfers\n\n**Active Session Protection**: Files in active session set are never auto-deleted regardless of age.\n\n## Verifying Deletion in Production\n\n### 1. Console Log Monitoring\n\nCheck browser console for deletion activity:\n\n**Successful manual deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.000Z\" \n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  duration: \"12.45ms\" \n}\n```\n\n**Failed deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Failed to delete output {\n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\",\n  error: {\n    name: \"NotFoundError\", \n    message: \"File not found\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 2. Startup Cleanup Verification\n\nCheck app initialization logs:\n\n```javascript\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n[Init] Orphaned outputs cleaned: 3\n```\n\n### 3. Storage Quota Monitoring\n\nMonitor storage usage changes after deletion:\n\n```javascript\n// Before deletion\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('Before:', e));\n\n// After deletion should show reduced usage\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('After:', e));\n```\n\n### 4. Programmatic Verification\n\nUse the storage manager API to verify deletion:\n\n```typescript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\n\n// Check if file exists (should return null after deletion)\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (metadata === null) {\n  console.log('File successfully deleted');\n}\n\n// List all remaining files\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nconsole.log('Remaining files:', files.length);\n```\n\n## Troubleshooting Common Issues\n\n### Issue 1: Files Not Being Deleted Automatically\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- Old files accumulating in OPFS\n- No cleanup logs on app startup\n- Storage quota warnings\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check console for `[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...` log\n2. Verify `runStartupCleanup()` is called during app initialization\n3. Check if files are younger than 24-hour age threshold\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Verify startup cleanup is running\n// Check src/platform/init.ts for runAppInit() call\n\n// Lower age threshold for testing\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000 // 1 hour for testing\n});\n```\n\n### Issue 2: Manual Deletion Failing Silently\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- User clicks delete but file remains\n- No error toast shown\n- No console logs\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check browser console for `[Storage:Deletion]` logs\n2. Verify OPFS permissions\n3. Check if file is locked by another process\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Check if file exists before deletion\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (!metadata) {\n  console.log('File already deleted or never existed');\n}\n\n// Force refresh file list after deletion\nawait fileListUI.refreshFileList();\n```\n\n### Issue 3: Deletion Logs Show \"File Not Found\"\n\n**Symptoms:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Files not found (already deleted) {\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"example.jpg\"\n}\n```\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n- File was already deleted (normal condition)\n- Metadata/file mismatch\n- Race condition in deletion\n\n**Solutions:**\n- This is a **warning, not an error** - deletion is idempotent\n- File is already gone, no action needed\n- Verify UI file list is synchronized\n\n### Issue 4: OPFS Storage Quota Exhausted\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- New transfers fail with quota errors\n- Deletion doesn't free up space\n- `navigator.storage.estimate()` shows 0 available\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n```javascript\nconst estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();\nconsole.log('Available:', estimate.quota - estimate.usage);\nconsole.log('Usage:', estimate.usage);\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n1. **Manual cleanup**: Delete old files programmatically\n2. **Browser data clearing**: Clear site data via DevTools\n3. **Reduce orphan age**: Auto-cleanup more frequently\n\n```javascript\n// Emergency cleanup - delete all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nfor (const file of files) {\n  await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n}\n```\n\n### Issue 5: Deletion Performance Problems\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- UI freezes during deletion\n- Long duration times in logs\n- Multiple file deletions blocking UI\n\n**Diagnosis:**\nCheck deletion duration in logs:\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  duration: \"1250.45ms\"  // > 1 second indicates problem\n}\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Batch deletions with delays to avoid UI blocking\nasync function deleteMultipleFiles(streamIds: number[]) {\n  for (const streamId of streamIds) {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(streamId);\n    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // 100ms delay\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Manual OPFS Cleanup\n\n### When Manual Cleanup Is Needed\n\n- Automatic cleanup failing to run\n- Emergency storage quota recovery\n- Testing and development scenarios\n- User-requested data clearing\n\n### Method 1: Using Browser DevTools\n\n1. **Open DevTools** → Application → Storage\n2. **Find OPFS** section under \"Storage\"\n3. **Locate origin** for your Data\n\n```javascript\n// Clear all OPFS data for the origin\nawait navigator.storage.delete();\n\n// Alternatively, use clear site data via browser UI\n// Chrome: Settings → Privacy → Site Settings → Storage → Your site\n```\n\n### Method 4: Low-Level OPFS Access\n\n```javascript\n// Direct OPFS access for advanced troubleshooting\nconst root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\nconst File Creation\n\nWhen a file is successfully received and decoded:\n\n```\n[Storage] Stored output: streamId=123, size=1024000\n```\n\nFiles are stored in OPFS under `screenferry-outputs/` directory:\n- **Data file**: `output-{streamId}.bin`\n- **Metadata file**: `output-{streamId}.meta.json`\n\n### 2. Active Retention\n\nFiles are **retained** during active transfers:\n- File remains in OPFS while transfer is in progress\n- File remains accessible after successful completion\n- User can download/view the completed file\n\n### 3. Manual Deletion\n\nUsers can manually delete files via the File List UI:\n\n```\n[FileListUI] Deleted file: example.jpg (streamId: 123)\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Data file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.bin\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Metadata file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.meta.json\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { streamId: 123, duration: \"12.45ms\" }\n```\n\n### 4. Automatic Cleanup\n\nOrphaned files are automatically cleaned up on app startup:\n\n```\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleaning up orphaned output: streamId=123, age=45 minutes\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n```\n\n## When Files Are Deleted vs Retained\n\n### Files Are Deleted Automatically When:\n\n1. **Orphaned files on startup**: Files older than 24 hours without active session reference\n2. **Age threshold reached**: `createdAt` timestamp exceeds `maxOrphanAge` (default: 24 hours)\n3. **No active session**: File's `streamId` not in active session set\n\n### Files Are Retained When:\n\n1. **Active transfer**: File is part of an ongoing transfer session\n2. **Recent completion**: File was created recently (within 24 hours)\n3. **Active session reference**: File belongs to a paused/resumable session\n4. **User intent**: File hasn't been manually deleted by user\n\n### Deletion Safety Mechanisms\n\n**Age Threshold Protection**: Prevents accidental deletion during:\n- Normal app restart (browser update, device reboot)\n- Session resume (paused sessions becoming active again)\n- Brief app closure during long transfers\n\n**Active Session Protection**: Files in active session set are never auto-deleted regardless of age.\n\n## Verifying Deletion in Production\n\n### 1. Console Log Monitoring\n\nCheck browser console for deletion activity:\n\n**Successful manual deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.000Z\" \n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  duration: \"12.45ms\" \n}\n```\n\n**Failed deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Failed to delete output {\n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\",\n  error: {\n    name: \"NotFoundError\", \n    message: \"File not found\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 2. Startup Cleanup Verification\n\nCheck app initialization logs:\n\n```javascript\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n[Init] Orphaned outputs cleaned: 3\n```\n\n### 3. Storage Quota Monitoring\n\nMonitor storage usage changes after deletion:\n\n```javascript\n// Before deletion\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('Before:', e));\n\n// After deletion should show reduced usage\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('After:', e));\n```\n\n### 4. Programmatic Verification\n\nUse the storage manager API to verify deletion:\n\n```typescript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\n\n// Check if file exists (should return null after deletion)\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (metadata === null) {\n  console.log('File successfully deleted');\n}\n\n// List all remaining files\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nconsole.log('Remaining files:', files.length);\n```\n\n## Troubleshooting Common Issues\n\n### Issue 1: Files Not Being Deleted Automatically\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- Old files accumulating in OPFS\n- No cleanup logs on app startup\n- Storage quota warnings\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check console for `[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...` log\n2. Verify `runStartupCleanup()` is called during app initialization\n3. Check if files are younger than 24-hour age threshold\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Verify startup cleanup is running\n// Check src/platform/init.ts for runAppInit() call\n\n// Lower age threshold for testing\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000 // 1 hour for testing\n});\n```\n\n### Issue 2: Manual Deletion Failing Silently\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- User clicks delete but file remains\n- No error toast shown\n- No console logs\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check browser console for `[Storage:Deletion]` logs\n2. Verify OPFS permissions\n3. Check if file is locked by another process\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Check if file exists before deletion\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (!metadata) {\n  console.log('File already deleted or never existed');\n}\n\n// Force refresh file list after deletion\nawait fileListUI.refreshFileList();\n```\n\n### Issue 3: Deletion Logs Show \"File Not Found\"\n\n**Symptoms:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Files not found (already deleted) {\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"example.jpg\"\n}\n```\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n- File was already deleted (normal condition)\n- Metadata/file mismatch\n- Race condition in deletion\n\n**Solutions:**\n- This is a **warning, not an error** - deletion is idempotent\n- File is already gone, no action needed\n- Verify UI file list is synchronized\n\n### Issue 4: OPFS Storage Quota Exhausted\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- New transfers fail with quota errors\n- Deletion doesn't free up space\n- `navigator.storage.estimate()` shows 0 available\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n```javascript\nconst estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();\nconsole.log('Available:', estimate.quota - estimate.usage);\nconsole.log('Usage:', estimate.usage);\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n1. **Manual cleanup**: Delete old files programmatically\n2. **Browser data clearing**: Clear site data via DevTools\n3. **Reduce orphan age**: Auto-cleanup more frequently\n\n```javascript\n// Emergency cleanup - delete all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nfor (const file of files) {\n  await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n}\n```\n\n### Issue 5: Deletion Performance Problems\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- UI freezes during deletion\n- Long duration times in logs\n- Multiple file deletions blocking UI\n\n**Diagnosis:**\nCheck deletion duration in logs:\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  duration: \"1250.45ms\"  // > 1 second indicates problem\n}\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Batch deletions with delays to avoid UI blocking\nasync function deleteMultipleFiles(streamIds: number[]) {\n  for (const streamId of streamIds) {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(streamId);\n    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // 100ms delay\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Manual OPFS Cleanup\n\n### When Manual Cleanup Is Needed\n\n- Automatic cleanup failing to run\n- Emergency storage quota recovery\n- Testing and development scenarios\n- User-requested data clearing\n\n### Method 1: Using Browser DevTools\n\n1. **Open DevTools** → Application → Storage\n2. **Find OPFS** section under \"Storage\"\n3. **Locate origin** for your ScreenFerry app\n4. **Expand \"File System\"** to see stored files\n5. **Delete files individually** or clear entire origin\n\n### Method 2: Using Storage Manager API\n\n```javascript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Get all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\n\n// Delete specific file\nawait storage.deleteOutput(streamId, filename);\n\n// Delete all files (emergency cleanup)\nfor (const file of files) {\n  try {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n    console.log(`Deleted: ${file.filename}`);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`Failed to delete: ${file.filename}`, error);\n  }\n}\n\n// Run orphaned cleanup manually\nconst activeIds = new Set<number>(); // No active sessions\nconst cleaned = await storage.cleanupOrphanedOutputs(activeIds);\nconsole.log(`Cleaned ${cleaned} orphaned files`);\n```\n\n### Method 3: Clear Site Data\n\n```javascript\n// Clear all OPFS data for the origin\nawait navigator.storage.delete();\n\n// Alternatively, use clear site data via browser UI\n// Chrome: Settings → Privacy → Site Settings → Storage → Your site\n```\n\n### Method 4: Low-Level OPFS Access\n\n```javascript\n// Direct OPFS access for advanced troubleshooting\nconst root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\nconst outputsDir = await root.getDirectoryHandle('screenferry-outputs');\n\n// List all files\nfor await (const entry of outputsDir.values()) {\n  console.log('File:', entry.name);\n  \n  // Delete specific file\n  if (entry.kind === 'file') {\n    await outputsDir.removeEntry(entry.name);\n    console.log('Deleted:', entry.name);\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Log Output Examples\n\n### Successful Manual MB\n```\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n### Local-Diagnostics Rule\n\n**IMPORTANT**: Never log actual file payload bytes or user data in deletion logs. The deletion logging follows the local-diagnostics rule (bf-1zxy):\n\n✅ **Safe to log:**\n- File metadata (name, size, type)\n- Stream IDs\n- Timestamps\n- Operation status\n- Performance metrics\n\n❌ **Never log:**\n- File contents/payload bytes\n- Decoded data\n- User-sensitive information\n\n### Same-Origin Protection\n\n- OPFS is origin-private, no cross-origin access\n- Cleanup only removes app's own output files\n- No risk of deleting data from other origins\n\n### User Confirmation\n\nManual deletions require user confirmation:\n```javascript\n// File list UI shows confirmation dialog\nconfirm(\"Are you sure you want to delete 'photo.jpg'?\\n\\nThis action cannot be undone.\");\n```\n\n## Performance Considerations\n\n### Deletion Performance\n\nTypical deletion durations:\n- **Single file**: 5-15ms\n- **Batch cleanup (10 files)**: 50-150ms\n- **Large files (>100MB)**: 10-50ms\n\nOPFS deletion is very fast as it only removes filesystem metadata, not data blocks.\n\n### Startup Cleanup Performance\n\n- **Non-blocking**: Runs in background during app init\n- **Typical case**: 0-2 orphaned files (~10-30ms total)\n- **Worst case**: 10+ orphaned files (~100-300ms total)\n\n### Memory Usage\n\n- **Listing files**: Minimal, only metadata loaded\n- **Deletion operations**: No significant memory allocation\n- **Cleanup batch processing**: One file at a time, no large buffers\n\n## Configuration\n\n### Storage Manager Configuration\n\n```typescript\ninterface StorageManagerConfig {\n  outputDirectory: string;      // OPFS subdirectory (default: 'screenferry-outputs')\n  maxOrphanAge: number;        // Max age for orphans in ms (default: 24 hours)\n}\n```\n\n### Custom Configuration\n\n```typescript\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Must be called before first getStorageManager() call\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  outputDirectory: 'custom-outputs',\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour for aggressive cleanup\n});\n```\n\n### Age Threshold Guidelines\n\n| Scenario | Recommended Age | Rationale |\n|----------|----------------|-----------|\n| **Production** | 24 hours | Prevents false positives during normal app restart |\n| **Testing/Dev** | 1 hour | Faster cleanup for debugging |\n| **Long transfers** | 48 hours | Allows for pauses in multi-hour transfers |\n| **Aggressive This ensures users don't lose their files if export doesn't complete.","originalFile":"# Deletion Lifecycle and Troubleshooting Guide (bf-9g4i)\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document explains the complete deletion lifecycle for receiver output files in ScreenFerry, including when files are automatically deleted versus retained, how to verify deletion is working correctly, and how to troubleshoot common deletion issues.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Deletion Lifecycle](#deletion-lifecycle)\n- [When Files Are Deleted vs Retained](#when-files-are-deleted-vs-retained)\n- [Verifying Deletion in Production](#verifying-deletion-in-production)\n- [Troubleshooting Common Issues](#troubleshooting-common-issues)\n- [Manual OPFS Cleanup](#manual-opfs-cleanup)\n- [Log Output Examples](#log-output-examples)\n\n## Deletion Lifecycle\n\n### 1. File Creation\n\nWhen a file is successfully received and decoded:\n\n```\n[Storage] Stored output: streamId=123, size=1024000\n```\n\nFiles are stored in OPFS under `screenferry-outputs/` directory:\n- **Data file**: `output-{streamId}.bin`\n- **Metadata file**: `output-{streamId}.meta.json`\n\n### 2. Active Retention\n\nFiles are **retained** during active transfers:\n- File remains in OPFS while transfer is in progress\n- File remains accessible after successful completion\n- User can download/view the completed file\n\n### 3. Export-Triggered Automatic Deletion ⭐\n\n**IMPORTANT**: Files are automatically deleted immediately after successful export operations. This is a key security feature to minimize plaintext storage time.\n\n**After Web Share API:**\n```\n[Export:Deletion] Starting deletion after share, {\n  method: \"share\",\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"photo.jpg\",\n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.000Z\"\n}\n[Export:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully, {\n  method: \"share\",\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"photo.jpg\",\n  duration: \"42.15ms\",\n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.042Z\"\n}\n```\n\n**After File System Access API save:**\n```\n[Export:Deletion] Starting deletion after save, {\n  method: \"save\",\n  streamId: 456,\n  filename: \"document.pdf\"\n}\n[Export:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully, { method: \"save\", ... }\n```\n\n**After traditional download:**\n```\n[Export:Deletion] Starting deletion after download, {\n  method: \"download\",\n  streamId: 789,\n  filename: \"archive.zip\"\n}\n[Export:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully, { method: \"download\", ... }\n```\n\n**Security Rationale**: OPFS stores files in plaintext. Immediate deletion after successful export minimizes the window where sensitive data persists in browser storage.\n\n### 4. Manual Deletion\n\nUsers can manually delete files via the File List UI:\n\n```\n[FileListUI] Deleted file: example.jpg (streamId: 123)\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Data file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.bin\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Metadata file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.meta.json\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { streamId: 123, duration: \"12.45ms\" }\n```\n\n### 5. Navigation Guard Deletion\n\nWhen users leave pages with partial (incomplete) artefacts, they can choose to delete the partial file:\n\n```\n[NavigationGuard] User chose to delete partial artefact: streamId=999\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 999, filename: \"partial-download.jpg\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { streamId: 999, ... }\n```\n\n### 6. Automatic Startup Cleanup\n\nOrphaned files are automatically cleaned up on app startup:\n\n```\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleaning up orphaned output: streamId=123, age=45 minutes\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n```\n\n## When Files Are Deleted vs Retained\n\n### Files Are Deleted Automatically When:\n\n1. **Orphaned files on startup**: Files older than 24 hours without active session reference\n2. **Age threshold reached**: `createdAt` timestamp exceeds `maxOrphanAge` (default: 24 hours)\n3. **No active session**: File's `streamId` not in active session set\n\n### Files Are Retained When:\n\n1. **Active transfer**: File is part of an ongoing transfer session\n2. **Recent completion**: File was created recently (within 24 hours)\n3. **Active session reference**: File belongs to a paused/resumable session\n4. **User intent**: File hasn't been manually deleted by user\n\n### Deletion Safety Mechanisms\n\n**Age Threshold Protection**: Prevents accidental deletion during:\n- Normal app restart (browser update, device reboot)\n- Session resume (paused sessions becoming active again)\n- Brief app closure during long transfers\n\n**Active Session Protection**: Files in active session set are never auto-deleted regardless of age.\n\n## Verifying Deletion in Production\n\n### 1. Console Log Monitoring\n\nCheck browser console for deletion activity:\n\n**Successful manual deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.000Z\" \n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  duration: \"12.45ms\" \n}\n```\n\n**Failed deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Failed to delete output {\n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\",\n  error: {\n    name: \"NotFoundError\", \n    message: \"File not found\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 2. Startup Cleanup Verification\n\nCheck app initialization logs:\n\n```javascript\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n[Init] Orphaned outputs cleaned: 3\n```\n\n### 3. Storage Quota Monitoring\n\nMonitor storage usage changes after deletion:\n\n```javascript\n// Before deletion\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('Before:', e));\n\n// After deletion should show reduced usage\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('After:', e));\n```\n\n### 4. Programmatic Verification\n\nUse the storage manager API to verify deletion:\n\n```typescript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\n\n// Check if file exists (should return null after deletion)\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (metadata === null) {\n  console.log('File successfully deleted');\n}\n\n// List all remaining files\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nconsole.log('Remaining files:', files.length);\n```\n\n## Troubleshooting Common Issues\n\n### Issue 1: Files Not Being Deleted Automatically\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- Old files accumulating in OPFS\n- No cleanup logs on app startup\n- Storage quota warnings\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check console for `[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...` log\n2. Verify `runStartupCleanup()` is called during app initialization\n3. Check if files are younger than 24-hour age threshold\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Verify startup cleanup is running\n// Check src/platform/init.ts for runAppInit() call\n\n// Lower age threshold for testing\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000 // 1 hour for testing\n});\n```\n\n### Issue 2: Manual Deletion Failing Silently\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- User clicks delete but file remains\n- No error toast shown\n- No console logs\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check browser console for `[Storage:Deletion]` logs\n2. Verify OPFS permissions\n3. Check if file is locked by another process\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Check if file exists before deletion\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (!metadata) {\n  console.log('File already deleted or never existed');\n}\n\n// Force refresh file list after deletion\nawait fileListUI.refreshFileList();\n```\n\n### Issue 3: Deletion Logs Show \"File Not Found\"\n\n**Symptoms:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Files not found (already deleted) {\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"example.jpg\"\n}\n```\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n- File was already deleted (normal condition)\n- Metadata/file mismatch\n- Race condition in deletion\n\n**Solutions:**\n- This is a **warning, not an error** - deletion is idempotent\n- File is already gone, no action needed\n- Verify UI file list is synchronized\n\n### Issue 4: OPFS Storage Quota Exhausted\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- New transfers fail with quota errors\n- Deletion doesn't free up space\n- `navigator.storage.estimate()` shows 0 available\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n```javascript\nconst estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();\nconsole.log('Available:', estimate.quota - estimate.usage);\nconsole.log('Usage:', estimate.usage);\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n1. **Manual cleanup**: Delete old files programmatically\n2. **Browser data clearing**: Clear site data via DevTools\n3. **Reduce orphan age**: Auto-cleanup more frequently\n\n```javascript\n// Emergency cleanup - delete all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nfor (const file of files) {\n  await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n}\n```\n\n### Issue 5: Deletion Performance Problems\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- UI freezes during deletion\n- Long duration times in logs\n- Multiple file deletions blocking UI\n\n**Diagnosis:**\nCheck deletion duration in logs:\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  duration: \"1250.45ms\"  // > 1 second indicates problem\n}\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Batch deletions with delays to avoid UI blocking\nasync function deleteMultipleFiles(streamIds: number[]) {\n  for (const streamId of streamIds) {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(streamId);\n    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // 100ms delay\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Manual OPFS Cleanup\n\n### When Manual Cleanup Is Needed\n\n- Automatic cleanup failing to run\n- Emergency storage quota recovery\n- Testing and development scenarios\n- User-requested data clearing\n\n### Method 1: Using Browser DevTools\n\n1. **Open DevTools** → Application → Storage\n2. **Find OPFS** section under \"Storage\"\n3. **Locate origin** for your ScreenFerry app\n4. **Expand \"File System\"** to see stored files\n5. **Delete files individually** or clear entire origin\n\n### Method 2: Using Storage Manager API\n\n```javascript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Get all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\n\n// Delete specific file\nawait storage.deleteOutput(streamId, filename);\n\n// Delete all files (emergency cleanup)\nfor (const file of files) {\n  try {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n    console.log(`Deleted: ${file.filename}`);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`Failed to delete: ${file.filename}`, error);\n  }\n}\n\n// Run orphaned cleanup manually\nconst activeIds = new Set<number>(); // No active sessions\nconst cleaned = await storage.cleanupOrphanedOutputs(activeIds);\nconsole.log(`Cleaned ${cleaned} orphaned files`);\n```\n\n### Method 3: Clear Site Data\n\n```javascript\n// Clear all OPFS data for the origin\nawait navigator.storage.delete();\n\n// Alternatively, use clear site data via browser UI\n// Chrome: Settings → Privacy → Site Settings → Storage → Your site\n```\n\n### Method 4: Low-Level OPFS Access\n\n```javascript\n// Direct OPFS access for advanced troubleshooting\nconst root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\nconst outputsDir = await root.getDirectoryHandle('screenferry-outputs');\n\n// List all files\nfor await (const entry of outputsDir.values()) {\n  console.log('File:', entry.name);\n  \n  // Delete specific file\n  if (entry.kind === 'file') {\n    await outputsDir.removeEntry(entry.name);\n    console.log('Deleted:', entry.name);\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Log Output Examples\n\n### Successful Manual The deletion logging follows the local-diagnostics rule (bf-1zxy):\n\n✅ **Safe to log:**\n- File metadata (name, size, type)\n- Stream IDs\n- Timestamps\n- Operation status\n- Performance metrics\n\n❌ **Never log:**\n- File contents/payload bytes\n- Decoded data\n- User-sensitive information\n\n### Same-Origin Protection\n\n- OPFS is origin-private, no cross-origin access\n- Cleanup only removes app's own output files\n- No risk of deleting data from other origins\n\n### User Confirmation\n\nManual deletions require user confirmation:\n```javascript\n// File list UI shows confirmation dialog\nconfirm(\"Are you sure you want to delete 'photo.jpg'?\\n\\nThis action cannot be undone.\");\n```\n\n## Performance Considerations\n\n### Deletion Performance\n\nTypical deletion durations:\n- **Single file**: 5-15ms\n- **Batch cleanup (10 files)**: 50-150ms\n- **Large files (>100MB)**: 10-50ms\n\nOPFS deletion is very fast as it only removes filesystem metadata, not data blocks.\n\n### Startup Cleanup Performance\n\n- **Non-blocking**: Runs in background during app init\n- **Typical case**: 0-2 orphaned files (~10-30ms total)\n- **Worst case**: 10+ orphaned files (~100-300ms total)\n\n### Memory Usage\n\n- **Listing files**: Minimal, only metadata loaded\n- **Deletion operations**: No significant memory allocation\n- **Cleanup batch processing**: One file at a time, no large buffers\n\n## Configuration\n\n### Storage Manager Configuration\n\n```typescript\ninterface StorageManagerConfig {\n  outputDirectory: string;      // OPFS subdirectory (default: 'screenferry-outputs')\n  maxOrphanAge: number;        // Max age for orphans in ms (default: 24 hours)\n}\n```\n\n### Custom Configuration\n\n```typescript\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Must be called before first getStorageManager() call\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  outputDirectory: 'custom-outputs',\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour for aggressive cleanup\n});\n```\n\n### Age Threshold Guidelines\n\n| Scenario | Recommended Age | Rationale |\n|----------|----------------|-----------|\n| **Production** | 24 hours | Prevents false positives during normal app restart |\n| **Testing/Dev** | 1 hour | Faster cleanup for debugging |\n| **Long transfers** | 48 hours | Allows for pauses in multi-hour transfers |\n| **Aggressive cleanup** | 30 minutes | For storage-constrained environments |\n\n## Monitoring and Metrics\n\n### Key Metrics to Track\n\n1. **Deletion success rate**: Successful deletions / total deletion attempts\n2. **Cleanup frequency**: How often startup cleanup runs\n3. **Orphaned file count**: Average number of files cleaned per startup\n4. **Storage usage trend**: OPFS usage over time\n5. orphanedCleaned: 0,\n  totalDuration: 0\n};\n\n// Log metrics periodically\nconsole.log('[Metrics] Deletion stats:', deletionMetrics);\n```\n\n## Related Documentation\n\n- **Startup Cleanup**: document explains the complete deletion lifecycle for receiver output files in ScreenFerry, including when files are automatically deleted versus retained, how to verify deletion is working correctly, and how to troubleshoot common deletion issues.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Deletion Lifecycle](#deletion-lifecycle)\n- [When Files Are Deleted vs Retained](#when-files-are-deleted-vs-retained)\n- [Verifying Deletion in Production](#verifying-deletion-in-production)\n- [Troubleshooting Common Issues](#troubleshooting-common-issues)\n- [Manual OPFS Cleanup](#manual-opfs-cleanup)\n- [Log Output Examples](#log-output-examples)\n\n## Deletion Lifecycle\n\n### 1. File Creation\n\nWhen a file is successfully received and decoded:\n\n```\n[Storage] Stored output: streamId=123, size=1024000\n```\n\nFiles are stored in OPFS under `screenferry-outputs/` directory:\n- **Data file**: `output-{streamId}.bin`\n- **Metadata file**: `output-{streamId}.meta.json`\n\n### 2. Active Retention\n\nFiles are **retained** during active transfers:\n- File remains in OPFS while transfer is in progress\n- File remains accessible after successful completion\n- User can download/view the completed file\n\n### 3. Export-Triggered Automatic Deletion ⭐\n\n**IMPORTANT**: Files are automatically deleted immediately after successful export operations. This is a key security feature to minimize plaintext storage time.\n\n**After Web Share API:**\n```\n[Export:Deletion] Starting deletion after share, {\n  method: \"share\",\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"photo.jpg\",\n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.000Z\"\n}\n[Export:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully, {\n  method: \"share\",\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"photo.jpg\",\n  duration: \"42.15ms\",\n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.042Z\"\n}\n```\n\n**After File System Access API save:**\n```\n[Export:Deletion] Starting deletion after save, {\n  method: \"save\",\n  streamId: 456,\n  filename: \"document.pdf\"\n}\n[Export:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully, { method: \"save\", ... }\n```\n\n**After traditional download:**\n```\n[Export:Deletion] Starting deletion after download, {\n  method: \"download\",\n  streamId: 789,\n  filename: \"archive.zip\"\n}\n[Export:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully, { method: \"download\", ... }\n```\n\n**Security Rationale**: OPFS stores files in plaintext. Immediate deletion after successful export minimizes the window where sensitive data persists in browser storage.\n\n### 4. Manual Deletion\n\nUsers can manually delete files via the File List UI:\n\n```\n[FileListUI] Deleted file: example.jpg (streamId: 123)\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Data file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.bin\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Metadata file deleted { streamId: 123, file: \"output-123.meta.json\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { streamId: 123, duration: \"12.45ms\" }\n```\n\n### 5. Navigation Guard Deletion\n\nWhen users leave pages with partial (incomplete) artefacts, they can choose to delete the partial file:\n\n```\n[NavigationGuard] User chose to delete partial artefact: streamId=999\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 999, filename: \"partial-download.jpg\" }\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { streamId: 999, ... }\n```\n\n### 6. Automatic Startup Cleanup\n\nOrphaned files are automatically cleaned up on app startup:\n\n```\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleaning up orphaned output: streamId=123, age=45 minutes\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { streamId: 123, filename: \"example.jpg\" }\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n```\n\n## When Files Are Deleted vs Retained\n\n### Files Are Deleted Automatically When:\n\n1. **After successful export**: Immediately after share/save/download completes (T4b security feature)\n2. **Orphaned files on startup**: Files older than 24 hours without active session reference\n3. **Age threshold reached**: `createdAt` timestamp exceeds `maxOrphanAge` (default: 24 hours)\n4. **No active session**: File's `streamId` not in active session set\n5. **User chooses deletion**: User selects \"delete\" option when leaving page with partial artefact\n\n### Files Are Retained When:\n\n1. **Export fails or is cancelled**: If user cancels share/save, file is retained\n2. **Active transfer**: File is part of an ongoing transfer session\n3. **Recent completion**: File was created recently (within 24 hours)\n4. **Active session reference**: File belongs to a paused/resumable session\n5. **User chooses to keep**: User selects \"keep\" option for partial artefacts\n6. **Manual preservation**: User doesn't manually delete via File List UI\n\n### Export Deletion Criteria\n\n| Export Method | Deletion Timing | Deletion Condition |\n|--------------|----------------|-------------------|\n| **Web Share API** | Immediate after `share()` resolves | User successfully selected destination and shared |\n| **File System Access Save** | Immediate after `showSaveFilePicker()` completes | User successfully selected save location |\n| **Traditional Download** | Immediate after download starts | Download triggered successfully (not cancelled) |\n| **Export fails** | No deletion | Any error during export, user cancellation, or permission denial |\n\n**Key Point**: Export-triggered deletion only happens on **success**, not on failure or cancellation. This ensures users don't lose their files if export doesn't complete.\n\n### Deletion Safety Mechanisms\n\n**Age Threshold Protection**: Prevents accidental deletion during:\n- Normal app restart (browser update, device reboot)\n- Session resume (paused sessions becoming active again)\n- Brief app closure during long transfers\n\n**Active Session Protection**: Files in active session set are never auto-deleted regardless of age.\n\n## Verifying Deletion in Production\n\n### 1. Console Log Monitoring\n\nCheck browser console for deletion activity:\n\n**Successful manual deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Starting deletion { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  timestamp: \"2026-08-02T20:00:00.000Z\" \n}\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\", \n  duration: \"12.45ms\" \n}\n```\n\n**Failed deletion:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Failed to delete output {\n  streamId: 123, \n  filename: \"example.jpg\",\n  error: {\n    name: \"NotFoundError\", \n    message: \"File not found\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 2. Startup Cleanup Verification\n\nCheck app initialization logs:\n\n```javascript\n[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...\n[Storage] Cleanup complete: removed 3 orphaned output(s)\n[Init] Orphaned outputs cleaned: 3\n```\n\n### 3. Storage Quota Monitoring\n\nMonitor storage usage changes after deletion:\n\n```javascript\n// Before deletion\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('Before:', e));\n\n// After deletion should show reduced usage\nnavigator.storage.estimate().then(e => console.log('After:', e));\n```\n\n### 4. Programmatic Verification\n\nUse the storage manager API to verify deletion:\n\n```typescript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\n\n// Check if file exists (should return null after deletion)\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (metadata === null) {\n  console.log('File successfully deleted');\n}\n\n// List all remaining files\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nconsole.log('Remaining files:', files.length);\n```\n\n## Troubleshooting Common Issues\n\n### Issue 1: Files Not Being Deleted Automatically\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- Old files accumulating in OPFS\n- No cleanup logs on app startup\n- Storage quota warnings\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check console for `[Storage] Starting orphaned output cleanup...` log\n2. Verify `runStartupCleanup()` is called during app initialization\n3. Check if files are younger than 24-hour age threshold\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Verify startup cleanup is running\n// Check src/platform/init.ts for runAppInit() call\n\n// Lower age threshold for testing\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000 // 1 hour for testing\n});\n```\n\n### Issue 2: Manual Deletion Failing Silently\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- User clicks delete but file remains\n- No error toast shown\n- No console logs\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n1. Check browser console for `[Storage:Deletion]` logs\n2. Verify OPFS permissions\n3. Check if file is locked by another process\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Check if file exists before deletion\nconst metadata = await storage.getOutputMetadata(streamId);\nif (!metadata) {\n  console.log('File already deleted or never existed');\n}\n\n// Force refresh file list after deletion\nawait fileListUI.refreshFileList();\n```\n\n### Issue 3: Deletion Logs Show \"File Not Found\"\n\n**Symptoms:**\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Files not found (already deleted) {\n  streamId: 123,\n  filename: \"example.jpg\"\n}\n```\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n- File was already deleted (normal condition)\n- Metadata/file mismatch\n- Race condition in deletion\n\n**Solutions:**\n- This is a **warning, not an error** - deletion is idempotent\n- File is already gone, no action needed\n- Verify UI file list is synchronized\n\n### Issue 4: OPFS Storage Quota Exhausted\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- New transfers fail with quota errors\n- Deletion doesn't free up space\n- `navigator.storage.estimate()` shows 0 available\n\n**Diagnosis:**\n```javascript\nconst estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();\nconsole.log('Available:', estimate.quota - estimate.usage);\nconsole.log('Usage:', estimate.usage);\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n1. **Manual cleanup**: Delete old files programmatically\n2. **Browser data clearing**: Clear site data via DevTools\n3. **Reduce orphan age**: Auto-cleanup more frequently\n\n```javascript\n// Emergency cleanup - delete all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\nfor (const file of files) {\n  await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n}\n```\n\n### Issue 5: Deletion Performance Problems\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- UI freezes during deletion\n- Long duration times in logs\n- Multiple file deletions blocking UI\n\n**Diagnosis:**\nCheck deletion duration in logs:\n```javascript\n[Storage:Deletion] Deletion completed successfully { \n  duration: \"1250.45ms\"  // > 1 second indicates problem\n}\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n```javascript\n// Batch deletions with delays to avoid UI blocking\nasync function deleteMultipleFiles(streamIds: number[]) {\n  for (const streamId of streamIds) {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(streamId);\n    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // 100ms delay\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Manual OPFS Cleanup\n\n### When Manual Cleanup Is Needed\n\n- Automatic cleanup failing to run\n- Emergency storage quota recovery\n- Testing and development scenarios\n- User-requested data clearing\n\n### Method 1: Using Browser DevTools\n\n1. **Open DevTools** → Application → Storage\n2. **Find OPFS** section under \"Storage\"\n3. **Locate origin** for your ScreenFerry app\n4. **Expand \"File System\"** to see stored files\n5. **Delete files individually** or clear entire origin\n\n### Method 2: Using Storage Manager API\n\n```javascript\nimport { getStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Get all files\nconst storage = getStorageManager();\nconst files = await storage.listOutputs();\n\n// Delete specific file\nawait storage.deleteOutput(streamId, filename);\n\n// Delete all files (emergency cleanup)\nfor (const file of files) {\n  try {\n    await storage.deleteOutput(file.streamId, file.filename);\n    console.log(`Deleted: ${file.filename}`);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`Failed to delete: ${file.filename}`, error);\n  }\n}\n\n// Run orphaned cleanup manually\nconst activeIds = new Set<number>(); // No active sessions\nconst cleaned = await storage.cleanupOrphanedOutputs(activeIds);\nconsole.log(`Cleaned ${cleaned} orphaned files`);\n```\n\n### Method 3: Clear Site Data\n\n```javascript\n// Clear all OPFS data for the origin\nawait navigator.storage.delete();\n\n// Alternatively, use clear site data via browser UI\n// Chrome: Settings → Privacy → Site Settings → Storage → Your site\n```\n\n### Method 4: Low-Level OPFS Access\n\n```javascript\n// Direct OPFS access for advanced troubleshooting\nconst root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\nconst outputsDir = await root.getDirectoryHandle('screenferry-outputs');\n\n// List all files\nfor await (const entry of outputsDir.values()) {\n  console.log('File:', entry.name);\n  \n  // Delete specific file\n  if (entry.kind === 'file') {\n    await outputsDir.removeEntry(entry.name);\n    console.log('Deleted:', entry.name);\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Log Output Examples\n\n### Successful Manual MB\n```\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n### Local-Diagnostics Rule\n\n**IMPORTANT**: Never log actual file payload bytes or user data in deletion logs. The deletion logging follows the local-diagnostics rule (bf-1zxy):\n\n✅ **Safe to log:**\n- File metadata (name, size, type)\n- Stream IDs\n- Timestamps\n- Operation status\n- Performance metrics\n\n❌ **Never log:**\n- File contents/payload bytes\n- Decoded data\n- User-sensitive information\n\n### Same-Origin Protection\n\n- OPFS is origin-private, no cross-origin access\n- Cleanup only removes app's own output files\n- No risk of deleting data from other origins\n\n### User Confirmation\n\nManual deletions require user confirmation:\n```javascript\n// File list UI shows confirmation dialog\nconfirm(\"Are you sure you want to delete 'photo.jpg'?\\n\\nThis action cannot be undone.\");\n```\n\n## Performance Considerations\n\n### Deletion Performance\n\nTypical deletion durations:\n- **Single file**: 5-15ms\n- **Batch cleanup (10 files)**: 50-150ms\n- **Large files (>100MB)**: 10-50ms\n\nOPFS deletion is very fast as it only removes filesystem metadata, not data blocks.\n\n### Startup Cleanup Performance\n\n- **Non-blocking**: Runs in background during app init\n- **Typical case**: 0-2 orphaned files (~10-30ms total)\n- **Worst case**: 10+ orphaned files (~100-300ms total)\n\n### Memory Usage\n\n- **Listing files**: Minimal, only metadata loaded\n- **Deletion operations**: No significant memory allocation\n- **Cleanup batch processing**: One file at a time, no large buffers\n\n## Configuration\n\n### Storage Manager Configuration\n\n```typescript\ninterface StorageManagerConfig {\n  outputDirectory: string;      // OPFS subdirectory (default: 'screenferry-outputs')\n  maxOrphanAge: number;        // Max age for orphans in ms (default: 24 hours)\n}\n```\n\n### Custom Configuration\n\n```typescript\nimport { configureStorageManager } from './platform/storage.js';\n\n// Must be called before first getStorageManager() call\nconfigureStorageManager({\n  outputDirectory: 'custom-outputs',\n  maxOrphanAge: 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour for aggressive cleanup\n});\n```\n\n### Age Threshold Guidelines\n\n| Scenario | Recommended Age | Rationale |\n|----------|----------------|-----------|\n| **Production** | 24 hours | Prevents false positives during normal app restart |\n| **Testing/Dev** | 1 hour | Faster cleanup for debugging |\n| **Long transfers** | 48 hours | Allows for pauses in multi-hour transfers |\n| **Aggressive cleanup** | 30 minutes | For storage-constrained environments |\n\n## Monitoring and Metrics\n\n### Key Metrics to Track\n\n1. **Deletion success rate**: Successful deletions / total deletion attempts\n2. **Cleanup frequency**: How often startup cleanup runs\n3. **Orphaned file count**: Average number of files cleaned per startup\n4. **Storage usage trend**: OPFS usage over time\n5. **Deletion latency**: Time to complete deletion operations\n\n### Production Monitoring\n\n```javascript\n// Track deletion metrics\nconst deletionMetrics = {\n  successful: 0,\n  failed: 0,\n
